verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Phoenix is free to self-host with no feature limitations, keeps data within your infrastructure, and can be fully air-gapped. They document many deployment paths (CLI via `uvx arize-phoenix serve`, Docker/Compose, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS CloudFormation, Cloud Run, Azure, Railway, Render) and give guidance on pinning versioned Docker images for production. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments (the only community item is a generic recommendation).
